title: Move Chat And Settings To Navbar Toggle Buttons
description: Move chat and settings from the right panel tabs to separate navbar toggle buttons. Place them next to right/left panel toggles with the same icon style. Only one of chat, settings, or right panel can be active at a time. They render in the same place/size as the right panel. Remove them as tabs from the right panel.
summary: Moved chat and settings from right panel tabs to dedicated navbar toggle buttons. Added ChatIcon and SettingsIcon toggles next to left/right panel toggles in PanelToggles component. Made chat, settings, and rightSidePanel mutually exclusive via EXCLUSIVE_SIDE_PANEL_KEYS. Removed all addSidePanelTab right calls for chat/settings from Kit, Design, Type, Quality, Home, and Docs apps. LayoutWrapper renders chat/settings content as single-tab right side panel when navbar toggle active. Updated tests.
